title: Short-Sale Approval — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction
content:
# Short-sale approval — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

The short-sale approval sets, on the payoff case of an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record, the contract price, the allowed closing costs, the required payoff amount and the appraised value basis, from the purchase contract submission on file for the case.

**Plan boundary.** A contract that meets the Estate Market Sale Payoff minimum, the lesser of the case's statement balance and 95 percent of the appraised value basis, is never approved as a short sale.

**Reissued terms.** Reissued terms other than an approved retention payoff and a short-sale approval replace every figure and restart the good-through period, and every reissue is issued on request or when a new appraisal or revised contract is recorded; a short-sale approval on the payoff case of an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record sets the contract price, the allowed closing costs, the required payoff amount and the appraised value basis and keeps the current statement's date, good-through date, statement balance and per diem.

**When the approval is made.** The short-sale approval is not made until the payoff case carries an issued statement balance. A case without an issued statement balance carries no short-sale approval.

## Recording the approval

**Capability.** The tool approves the short-sale terms on a borrower's short-sale payoff case from the purchase contract submission named: the submission is marked accepted and the case records the contract price, the allowed closing costs, the required payoff amount and the appraised value basis passed in. The case's status, statement date, good-through date, statement balance, daily accrual and funds held are left unchanged. On success the case shows the approved contract figures and the amount the sale must deliver, and the submission shows status accepted.

**How it is invoked.** `approve_sale_closing_costs_11c6cfd9` is an agent-side tool that the agent unlocks and then calls.

**Parameters.**
- `payoff_case_id` — the reference number of the payoff case, as returned by the payoff case lookup.
- `payoff_request_id` — the reference number of the purchase contract submission being approved, as returned by the payoff submission lookup.
- `maturity_case_id` — the reference number of the loan's maturity case whose appraisal the terms rely on, as returned by the maturity case lookup.
- `contract_price` — the purchase price on the approved contract; USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent.
- `allowed_closing_costs` — the seller closing costs approved to come out of the price; USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent.
- `required_payoff_amount` — the amount the sale must deliver to satisfy the loan; USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent.
- `appraised_value_basis` — the as-is appraised value the terms rely on; USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent.

**Return.** A confirmation naming the payoff case, submission and maturity case reference numbers, the submission status accepted, the contract price, the allowed closing costs, the required payoff amount and the appraised value basis (USD, 2 decimal places); the word "approved" shows the write completed. No other return or error is defined for this tool.
